trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

missable.window: Pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, whenever that happens.

trophies.answer: The capstone: it pops when the underlying checklist work is complete - follow the roadmap stages in order and reconcile against the in-game checklist.

steps.text: Treat this as the sum of everything else in the casebook: it pops only when the underlying work is done, so work the roadmap stages in order.
Finish the story first (Stage 1 of the roadmap). The 100% checklist only becomes visible after the credits, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion - but everything you did earlier already counts.
Scan vehicles and study animals as you travel: the checklist wants 200 base-model vehicle scans and 100 animal studies, and both are far cheaper done opportunistically.
In Stage 2, clear the lines the checklist wants in full first: all robberies, all 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone time trials and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
Then take the partial lines to their marks only: 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations - going past the mark earns nothing here.
Reconcile weekly against the in-game checklist, not against any website's list: where sites disagree (and they do - see the register), the game's own Progress screen is the referee.
When the checklist reads 100%, the trophy pops; if one line is short, the Missables and Roadmap views in this casebook show which stage owns it.
